name: shift-and-spectrum
description: Shift & Spectrum (NASA Space Apps 2026). Root scripts forward to frontend/; dependencies live in frontend/package.json.

scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.backend:dev: uv --directory backend run uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory --host localhost --port 8000 --reload
scripts.backend:check: uv --directory backend run ruff check . && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check . && uv --directory backend run mypy && uv --directory backend run pytest -q
scripts.contract:gen: npm --prefix frontend run contract:gen && uv --directory backend run python -m scripts.generate_contract
scripts.contract:check: npm --prefix frontend run contract:check && uv --directory backend run python -m scripts.generate_contract --check
